{{CharInfobox |color={{Hoenn color}} |corecolor={{Hoenn color light}} |bordercolor={{Hoenn color dark}} |name=Brigette |jname=アズサ |tmname=Azusa |image=Brigette Bank.png |size=130px |caption=Art from [[Pokémon Bank]] by [[Megumi Mizutani]][[a:File:BrigetteBREAKthrough134.jpg|Brigette (BREAKthrough 134)]] |gender=Female |relatives=[[Lanette]] (younger sister) |region=[[Hoenn]] |game=yes |generation={{gen|III}}, {{gen|VI}} |games={{pkmn|Box Ruby & Sapphire}}, {{pkmn|Bank}} |footnotes=}} '''Brigette''' (Japanese: '''アズサ''' ''Azusa'') is the older sister of [[Lanette]] and the host of {{g|Box Ruby & Sapphire}} and [[Pokémon Bank]], as well as the developer of the latter.[https://web.archive.org/web/20131217101147/http://www.pokemonbank.com/en-gb/bank Link confirming Brigette is the one who developed Pokémon Bank in-universe] ==In the games== [[File:Pokémon Box RS Brigette In-Game.png|thumb|200px|left|Brigette in-game]] ===Pokémon Box Ruby & Sapphire=== She upgraded the [[Pokémon Storage System]] with the ability to hold 1,500 {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, and the ability to select and move multiple Pokémon at once. She is also generous, and will give away [[Pokémon Egg]]s containing special Pokémon if certain conditions are met. ===Pokémon Bank=== Brigette returns in [[Pokémon Bank]], an online paid cloud storage system for the [[Nintendo 3DS]] that complements the release of [[Pokémon X and Y]]. She is mentioned to be the developer of the Bank system. When the player deposits Pokémon, Brigette will award the {{player|user}} with their choice of [[Battle Point]]s or [[Poké Mile]]s. The amount received is dependent on the amount of Pokémon deposited and the amount of time they are deposited for. ===Pokémon=== ====Given away==== =====Pokémon Box Ruby & Sapphire===== :''Main article: [[List of game-based Pokémon distributions in Generation III#Pokémon Box Bonus Eggs|List of game-based Pokémon distributions in Generation III → Pokémon Box Bonus Eggs]]'' * {{p|Swablu}} with {{m|False Swipe}}: Brigette gives the player this Swablu {{pkmn|Egg}} at the start. {{Pokémon |gen=3 |ndex=0333 |pokemon=Swablu |level=5 ({{color2|000|Pokémon Egg|Egg}}) |type1=Normal|type2=Flying |ability=Natural Cure |move1=Peck|move1type=Flying |move2=Growl|move2type=Normal |move3=False Swipe|move3type=Normal}} * {{p|Zigzagoon}} with {{m|ExtremeSpeed}}: Brigette gives the player this Zigzagoon Egg after storing 100 Pokémon from one game. {{Pokémon |gen=3 |ndex=0263 |pokemon=Zigzagoon |level=5 ({{color2|000|Pokémon Egg|Egg}}) |type1=Normal |ability=Pickup |move1=Tackle|move1type=Normal |move2=Growl|move2type=Normal |move3=Tail Whip|move3type=Normal |move4=ExtremeSpeed|move4type=Normal}} * {{p|Skitty}} with {{m|Pay Day}}: Brigette gives the player this Skitty Egg after storing 500 Pokémon from one game. {{Pokémon |gen=3 |ndex=0300 |pokemon=Skitty |level=5 ({{color2|000|Pokémon Egg|Egg}}) |type1=Normal |ability=Cute Charm |move1=Tackle|move1type=Normal |move2=Growl|move2type=Normal |move3=Tail Whip|move3type=Normal |move4=Pay Day|move4type=Normal}} * {{p|Pichu}} with {{m|Surf}}: Brigette gives the player this Pichu Egg after storing 1,499 Pokémon from one game. {{Pokémon |gen=3 |ndex=0172 |pokemon=Pichu |level=5 ({{color2|000|Pokémon Egg|Egg}}) |type1=Electric |ability=Static |move1=Thunder Shock|move1type=Electric |move2=Charm|move2type=Normal |move3=Surf|move3type=Water}} ==Gallery== ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto;
